evidence: Has P2P label, updates Tor proxy network parsing in src/init.cpp, and updates doc/tor.md and proxy functional tests.
rationale: Fixes startup failures caused by stale CLI help text and documentation advising users to specify `-proxy=...=tor` after `tor` was removed as a valid network identifier in PR #34031. The change unifies `-proxy` parsing with `ParseNetwork()` and corrects user-facing instructions for Tor connectivity.
